title_similarity_candidates.title_a: Village Build Commons — community construction economy

manual_semantic_spot_checks.reason: Tree beetle habitat intervention vs companion-guided stranded-animal rescue; separate authoritative state and player actions.
Editable consent-governed storytelling vs newcomer welcoming ceremony; shared NPC consent must be centralized.
Verified favors and reciprocity vs opt-in life milestone archive; unify visibility and revocation semantics.
Glass casting/annealing vs seasonal condensation decoration; Foundry supplies actual panes and Frostlace owns only cosmetic mask.
Curing mortar under weather constraints vs astronomical appointment puzzle; no shared state owner.
Memorial garden dedications and social favors both handle consented resident memories; Village must own privacy permissions and revocation receipts.

features.title: Joinery Loom — six-mode tactile placement
features.scenario: Player selects a timber post, drags its translucent ghost near a wall anchor, holds a precision modifier to nudge 5 cm, switches to freeform when a socket is unsuitable, and commits or cancels without losing materials.

features.title: Groundweave — sculpt-to-foundation terrain kit
features.scenario: Player outlines a hillside cabin footprint, previews three alternative foundations and their costs, adjusts supports by dragging handles, and watches rain channels change before committing.

features.title: Framewright — inspectable house assembly timeline
features.scenario: Player raises foundation posts, braces a frame, sets walls and roof, opens a door, then decorates; unfinished buildings remain visible and safe through multiple seasons.

features.title: Rainroof Atelier — weather-reactive roof craft
features.scenario: Player tests two roof pitches in a rainstorm, installs a gutter to a barrel, then uses harvested rain to irrigate a greenhouse.

features.title: Roomheart — spatial rooms that remember life
features.scenario: Player partitions a loft into a kitchen and cozy bedroom; a villager moves into the bedroom after an invited household event and adjusts their schedule and comfort.

features.title: Hearth Threads — visible household utility weaving
features.scenario: Player runs a magical warmth-thread from a hearth to a bedroom, sees cold spots fade, then reroutes it around a blocked doorway.

features.title: Memory Blueprints — replayable house patterns
features.scenario: Player saves a custom cottage blueprint, carries it to a new valley plot, previews foundation substitutions and asks neighbors to help assemble its stages.

features.title: Village Build Commons — community construction economy
features.scenario: Player posts a village bridge repair, donates lumber, hires two neighbors for weekend shifts, and sees scaffolding and a repaired crossing appear as milestones finish.

features.title: Salvage Ledger — reversible renovation with provenance
features.scenario: Player remodels an old barn: removes a roof after supporting beams, salvages weathered planks, repairs them, and rebuilds a greenhouse without duplicating stock.

features.title: Seasonwright Homes — structures that respond to climate
features.scenario: Player reinforces a cottage before winter, adds a shaded veranda for summer, and chooses a green roof that attracts pollinators while raising upkeep.

features.title: Causality Loom — explainable world consequence director
features.scenario: Two dry days forecast a pollinator shortage. At the meadow noticeboard the player can plant flowers, request help, or defer; each choice visibly changes habitat and the following week's market.

features.title: Riverglass Accord — watershed habitat and fish migration
features.scenario: A silted tributary blocks silverfin spawning. The player samples three sites, plants reeds and proposes a seasonal catch limit; shoals and market supply respond across seasons.

features.title: Lantern Letters — consent-based promises and verifiable village stories
features.scenario: A baker asks the player to deliver a sealed letter. The recipient may decline, ask for evidence or respond; the player's respect for privacy changes later invitations.

features.title: Wayfarer Pulse — weather-aware caravan logistics and bounded markets
features.scenario: Mist delays a mountain caravan. The player escorts the shipment, substitutes local produce or postpones a feast, with visible stock and price consequences.

features.title: Starpath Almanac — fictional sky navigation and multi-route mysteries
features.scenario: On an autumn evening, the player rotates a carved star wheel against mountain silhouettes to reveal a hidden herb grove; winter mist offers an alternate grounded clue.

features.title: Wildsign Atlas — ethical wildlife migration and companion tracking
features.scenario: Follow seasonal hoofprints from the woods to the highlands, set a harmless observation hide and ask a trusted companion to locate a distant herd without capturing animals.

features.title: Tradition Seedbank — community-authored evolving celebrations
features.scenario: Propose next spring's lantern procession theme, invite musicians and choose a daytime route; residents remember who participated and may change next year's ceremony.

features.title: Pattern Orchard — authored textile motifs and maker exchange
features.scenario: Blend two farm-grown dyes, weave a scarf motif on a loom, then enter it into a village exhibition where NPC tastes affect limited demand.

features.title: Mistwake Passage — accessible canoe routes and hidden wetlands
features.scenario: A mist bank closes a direct canoe route. The player follows floating markers along a slower shoreline path to a herb island, with optional autopaddle for touch users.

features.title: Neighbor Chorus — consent-aware offline collaborative chores
features.scenario: Invite two villagers to gather apples and prepare supper. One prefers cooking, another is busy; negotiate roles and share a transparent reward while retaining solo completion.
